description: Forgejo Actions runner lane policy for the EdgeVector local forge. Every runner is a Mac host-mode runner. The gaming PC runners (pc-forge-runner, pc-heavy-runner) were retired on 2026-09-29 when Tom moved every EdgeVector dependency off the PC. Merge-blocking ci-required runs on the macos-arm64 host lane; release/deploy jobs use the Mac host lane via the macos label.

merge_gate.purpose: Pre-merge ci-required only. Keep capacity free for fold/lastgit PR gates.
merge_gate.notes: Mac merge runner is host-only macos-arm64 (docker label dropped 2026-07-13). No docker lane exists: the PC pc-forge-runner that served docker/* was retired 2026-09-29. Do not attach long release/deploy workflows to these labels.

heavy.purpose: Long-running non-gating work on Mac host runners. Release/deploy jobs (fold tags, exemem-infra deploys) use the macos label. The dedicated heavy label had no runner after pc-heavy-runner (PC docker) was retired on 2026-09-29; re-adding heavy:host to a Mac host runner is a deliberate decision. Never a required pre-merge status.

workflow_routing.example: release.yml / deploy jobs: runs-on: macos (Mac host). Leave ci-required needs: limited to merge-gate jobs only.

heavy.notes: pc-heavy-runner (PC docker, label heavy) was retired 2026-09-29. Until a Mac host runner re-adds heavy:host, `heavy` jobs queue (the lane is non-gating). Host-mode Mac runners stay capacity 1 so a release does not stack with another long job.

proof.expected: Local discovery only: no PC runner is expected. heavy_ok=true needs a Mac host home that advertises heavy:host again.
